name: Tiger Beetle
intro: A tiger beetle is a small, fast insect. It hunts other bugs.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A tiger beetle is a small insect.
Some tiger beetles are shiny green, blue, or purple.
Some have little spots on their backs.
It has big eyes that bulge out.
It has long, thin legs and big, curved jaws.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Tiger beetles live all over the world.
Many live in sunny, sandy places.
They run on beaches and sand dunes.
Some live on paths in the forest.
Baby tiger beetles live in holes in the ground.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Tiger beetles are predators.
They eat other insects and spiders.
They run fast to catch their food.
Babies wait in their holes for bugs to walk by.
Then they grab the bug with their jaws.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A mother lays her eggs in the ground.
A baby tiger beetle is called a larva.
The larva digs a burrow and lives in it.
A hump on its back helps it stay in its hole.
Then it becomes a pupa, and then an adult.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: Tiger beetles are some of the fastest insects.
They run so fast that they must stop to look again.
Tiger beetles can fly fast, too.
There are thousands of kinds of tiger beetles.
A burrow can be as deep as a baseball bat is long.

vocab.meaning: A small animal with six legs and three body parts.
An animal that hunts other animals for food.
A baby insect that looks like a worm.
A hole in the ground where an animal lives.
The resting time when a larva changes into an adult.
